criteria.criterion: Effective forward map = `local_to_jira_status` ← `default` ← `projects.<KEY>` via S1 `resolve_for_project`; a non-default overlay changes the outbound target through the real mapper — `test_status_config_effect`.

An unmapped status **drifts**: the mutation omits `status` (Jira unchanged) + a non-fatal warning, never skipped nor a failure — `test_unmapped_status_drifts`; the drift alert is deduped per-status per-process — `test_drift_warning_deduped_within_pass`.

A config remap AND a collapsed pair (OTHER than blocked/cancelled) round-trip losslessly via `rebar-status:<local>` labels, recovered inbound without a reverse map — `test_status_remap_roundtrip`/`test_status_collapse_roundtrip`.

The `outbound_differ` seam resolves the per-project map and reads `[mapping]` from the `repo_root`, not the CWD — `test_effective_status_map_for_resolves_project`, `test_effective_status_map_for_honors_repo_root`.

A config-only/remapped Jira status is tolerated by BOTH the fetcher known-set AND the post-mapper `preflight_status_mapping` — `test_fetcher_known_includes_config`, `test_preflight_tolerates_config_remap`.

The duplicated `_REBAR_STATUS_LABEL_TO_LOCAL` literal is retired for a shared helper (re-exported in `applier.__all__`) whose recovery vocab is DERIVED (not a divergent literal), covering every local status the stamp rule can emit — `test_status_label_helper_single_source`, `test_recovery_vocab_covers_every_local_status`.
